capture_buffer.harness:
import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
from native_program import read_build,execute,ROOT,require
from test_large_stacks import PIN
from test_gem_render import read_capture
from os_boundary import emulator,run_to
p=read_build(ROOT/'build/gem-stack-headroom/coexistence/program')
out=ROOT/'build/gem-stack-headroom/capture-buffer';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with emulator(ROOT/'build/shell-paced-bridge',ROOT/'build/firmware/altirraos-816.rom',out,pin=PIN) as b:
 def before(b):
  marker=p['labels']['native_nmi'];b.bp_set(marker);run_to(b,marker);b.bp_clear_all()
  memory=p['build']['memory'];buffer=memory['constants']['MANIFEST']
  source=p['image']['routines'][0]['address'];expected=b.memdump(source,4098)
  oldbuffer=b.memdump(buffer,4096);oldregs=b.regs()
  actual=read_capture(b,source,4098,p)
  require(actual==expected,'Copied bytes differ')
  require(oldbuffer==b.memdump(buffer,4096),'Borrowed buffer was not restored')
  after=b.regs()
  require(all(oldregs[k]==after[k] for k in ('PC','A','X','Y','S','P')),'Copy changed CPU context')
 runtime,_=execute(b,{**p,'output':out},before_run=before,frame_limit=12000,timeout=180)
 (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status='pass',tier='development',bytes=4098,source_build=str(p['output']),harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),runtime=runtime),indent=2)+'\n')
print('Capture buffer: bytes, CPU, borrowed RAM, guards and OS return passed')

maximum_edit.scope: Maximum 127-character Files field, rejected extra input, exposure/cancel and EXIT
maximum_edit.harness:
import sys,json,shutil,zipfile,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
from measure_gem_stacks import EditProbe
from test_demo import run
from native_program import require
from gem_applications import instances
from browser_model import FIELDS
root=Path('build/gem-stack-headroom');out=(root/'maximum-edit-final').resolve()
shutil.copytree(root/'final',out)
with zipfile.ZipFile(out/'exec816-demo.zip') as z:z.extractall(out/'extracted')
checks={}
class MaximumEdit:
 def exercise(self,s):
  app=next(a for a in instances(s.b,s.p,s.p['output']/'bitmap-console') if a['name']=='files')
  at=app['symbols']['GEMBrowser']+FIELDS['editText']
  read=lambda:s.b.memdump(at,128).split(b'\0')[0]
  def checkpoint(label):
   if label!='path-open':return
   for length in range(len(read())+1,128):
    s.press('A')
    s.rendezvous('db($%x)!=0'%(at+length-1))
    if length%32==0:print('Edit characters:',len(read()),flush=True)
   s.frames(90)
   expected=read();require(len(expected)==127,'Maximum editable length was not reached')
   s.press('A');s.frames(90)
   require(read()==expected and s.b.peek(at+127)==b'\0','Editing exceeded TEDINFO capacity')
   s.cells('maximum-edit-length')
   checks.update(maximum_characters=127,nul_preserved=True,overflow_ignored=True,pixels=True)
  s.stack_checkpoint=checkpoint
  EditProbe().exercise(s)
r=run(out,boot_smoke=True,distribution_root=out/'extracted/exec816-demo',integration=MaximumEdit(),profile_commands=False)
require(all(r['gem_stacks'][str(i)]['remaining_above_floor']>=128 for i in range(1,6)),'Application headroom below target')
r.update(scope='Maximum 127-character Files field, rejected extra input, exposure/cancel and EXIT',maximum_edit=checks,harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
(out/'maximum-edit-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Maximum-length edit passed:',{k:v['remaining_above_floor'] for k,v in r['gem_stacks'].items()})
